desc: Guy and Kakashi alter their course to reinforce a platoon engaged in battle with Ameyuri Ringo. Later, the ruthless warrior launches a devastating and unrelenting assault on Yurui's unit.

desc: Following the Kage Summit, Tsunade dispatches Team Kakashi to investigate a massacre at a region known as The Hole, whereupon she deeply regrets her inability to allocate additional reinforcements.

title: Naruto: Shippuden
desc: While conducting a thorough investigation of the village situated near Tonika, Naruto finds his path blocked by Kabuto. Later, a monumental clash erupts as a forbidden jutsu is unleashed.

title: Naruto: Shippuden
desc: Naruto and Sakura opt to spend the night at Shiseru's residence to assist in guarding the survivors. Meanwhile, Dokku and Shiseru dedicate themselves to uniting the orphans into a new family.
